messages:
anya: Heads-up: customers hitting weird timeout/retry combos on Android 13 with our Kotlin SDK. Retrofit 2.9 + OkHttp 4.11. Issue shows as duplicate POSTs after network blips, sometimes 409s from backend. Anyone seen this pattern?

mike: Could be our retry interceptor + coroutine adapter interacting badly. If a coroutine times out but the OkHttp call isn't cancelled before the interceptor retries, you end up with duplicate attempts.

leo: Also watch WorkManager / foreground service interactions. If a job gets preempted and re-enqueued, you can trigger duplicate network flows that look like SDK retries. But you said 409s, so likely same request repeated by client.

anya: Repro steps: 1) POST small payload, adapter has 10s callTimeout + Retrofit call wrapped in withTimeout(8_000). 2) Simulate network drop for ~3s. 3) Observe server receives two POSTs ~200ms apart. Logs:

```
I/SDK: issuing request POST /v1/events id=abc
W/Coroutine: withTimeout expired, cancelling job
I/OkHttp: interceptor retry attempt=1 for POST /v1/events id=abc
I/Server: Received POST id=abc
I/Server: Received POST id=abc
```

mike: That stack is classic: coroutine times out before OkHttp's callTimeout sees the socket loss, and your retry interceptor doesn't check call.isCanceled() before issuing the retry. Fix is to make retry interceptor abort on call.isCanceled() or ensure call.cancel() is executed synchronously from the coroutine cancellation path.

leo: We should also document best practices in onboarding: recommend aligning coroutine with network timeouts (avoid double timeouts) and prefer callTimeout over nested coroutine timeouts where possible. Add a sample showing correct wiring.

anya: I started a small PR that: (1) updates our RetryInterceptor to check call.isCanceled() before retrying, (2) adds a utility suspend function safeCall { client.newCall(request).await() } that wires invokeOnCancellation -> call.cancel(), and (3) documents the preferred timeout strategy. Link: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/2612>.

mike: Can you add a tiny sample app in devex/samples/android that demonstrates the anti-pattern and the corrected pattern? A short README in the sample would help support and newbies.

leo: Also add an integration test that asserts no duplicate POSTs during a simulated blip. Emulator can toggle network via adb and we can assert server received <=1 request. Make test tolerant to flakiness (retry a few times).

android-ci-bot: PR 2612 build queued on android-integration-tests (artifact: 8.5.0-beta).

anya: OK assigning: @mike finish the safeCall util + tests, @leo add sample + test, I'll update onboarding docs and add a short checklist: "align timeouts, cancel calls promptly, avoid retrying on cancelled calls". Thanks! :thumbsup:
